title: Create the Q2 close CFO decision note
prompt:
Create a concise Word document at:
`Deliverables/Q2 close CFO decision note - 7.2.docx`

Limit the note to two pages. Title it `Q2 close — CFO decision note` and label it `INTERNAL WORKING / NOT SUBMITTED`. Include one real Word table with rows for: proposed June WIP entry, downside liquidity, borrowing base, posted/pro-forma covenants, and midyear capex. The table must show the exact linked figures and decision/status for each row.

Begin with the CFO synthesis request in `Requests/`. Independently reconcile the WIP, downside liquidity, borrowing-base, covenant, and capital-allocation workstreams to their controlling system populations and source files; do not copy a single downstream summary as the authority for all five rows.

State that the WIP entry is proposed/unposted; identify the downside minimum pre-financing cash, draw week and maximum revolver; give the final borrowing base; show posted/pro-forma leverage and compliance; and state the capex cash requirement plus release-now/conditional/hold classifications. Add a short source list naming the accounting MCP and at least five controlling files spanning the five workstreams. Do not add unsupported narrative, sign the note, or represent it as lender-submitted. The DOCX is graded.
